additions.name: procurement_supplier_changes
additions.sql: CREATE TABLE procurement_supplier_changes(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,org_id TEXT NOT NULL,supplier_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES procurement_suppliers(id),revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision>0),active INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(active IN(0,1)),actor_id TEXT NOT NULL,reason TEXT NOT NULL,created_at TEXT NOT NULL,UNIQUE(org_id,supplier_id,revision)) STRICT
